messages:
Maya: Support flagged another ticket. Customer saw 503s and the console showed 'throttled' which sent them down the wrong playbook. We need clearer signal provenance (routing vs tenant quota vs model failure).
Eli: Agreed. Proposal: add a non-breaking JSON advisory field `error_provenance` and a short `reason_hint`. Keep HTTP status codes as-is. Example body: { "status":503, "error":"ServiceUnavailable", "error_provenance":"routing", "reason_hint":"transient congestion" }.
Tara: Prefer also adding an `x-rw-provenance` header for fast filtering at the edge. But note many CDNs strip unknown headers; body field should be canonical.
Sam: Telemetry side: emit metrics `errors.provenance` with tag `provenance` (routing|tenant|model|fallback) at 100%. Sample full traces (~1%) including route, model_version, and prompt_hash for debugging.
Maya: UX: console badges should be human-first. Draft copy: routing -> "Capacity pressure (try again)", tenant -> "Quota reached (contact billing)", model -> "Model error (fallback applied)". Each badge links to a short runbook.
Eli: SDKs: add `ErrorProvenance` enum and helper `isRetryable()`. Map routing->true, fallback->depends, tenant->false, model->false.
Tara: Privacy: headers must not include tenant identifiers. If support needs tenant context, pipe it to telemetry only. Add a dataplane linter to prevent PII leakage.
Sam: Rollout: feature-flag on platform for internal clusters, monitor for 72h, then enable hosted. Console display behind a feature flag as well. We'll deprecate opaque `INTERNAL` mapping after a 60-day notice.
Maya: Edge-case: fallback returned 200 but with degraded quality. Add `fallback_applied:true` and `quality_flag:degraded` in telemetry; console shows yellow badge with details.
Eli: Tests: integration through edge proxies, contract tests for SDKs, and dashboard queries for `errors.provenance`. I'll add alert playbooks (e.g., >3% model faults triggers page).
Tara: I'll mock badge visuals and the tooltip copy. Sam, can you prepare the instrumentation queries for the RFC?
Sam: On it. I'll include example KQL and a retention note for sampled traces.
Maya: Sounds like we have alignment. I'll write a short RFC and coordinate the canary once infra PR lands.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: `feature/error-provenance` -> canary group eng-plat-canary. Build 10456. :rocket:
